episodes.title: The Legendary Con Artist
episodes.summary: A naive young woman named Nao is dragged into the Liar Game and seeks the assistance of a notorious conman.

episodes.title: Shockwave
episodes.summary: Nao and Akiyama crank up the pressure to try to retrieve Nao's millions.

episodes.title: Resolution
episodes.summary: The first round of the Liar Game reaches its end and a new round begins.

episodes.title: Minority Rule
episodes.summary: Nao frets over her chance of survival as the rules of the Minority Rule game are explained.

episodes.title: Alliance
episodes.summary: Akiyama and Nao proceed further into the Minority Rule game with their alliance strategy.

episodes.title: The Losers' Revival
episodes.summary: The Minority Rule comes to its shocking conclusion, and Nao seeks a way to get back into the game.

episodes.title: Light and Darkness
episodes.summary: Nao makes a desperate ploy to climb out from the depths of despair.

episodes.title: Salvation
episodes.summary: The other Revival Round players scramble for the votes to save themselves.

episodes.title: Contraband Game
episodes.summary: Leronira introduces the surviving players to the complex rules of the Contraband Game.

episodes.title: Yokoya
episodes.summary: The game begins, and both teams lay out the strategies they will follow in the opening rounds.

episodes.title: Fissures
episodes.summary: Kikuzawa tests his surefire method for detecting contraband, while Akiyama and Nao try to figure out Yokoya.

episodes.title: Dictatorship
episodes.summary: The Country of Day team corners Kikuzawa to make him reveal how he knew Yokoya before entering the game.

episodes.title: Secret Plan
episodes.summary: Akiyama comes up with a plan to compensate for the Country of Day's weaknesses, but Yokoya also makes a move.

episodes.title: Turbulence
episodes.summary: Akiyama concocts a new plan to pull his team out of a hopeless situation.

episodes.title: Tip-off
episodes.summary: The curtain is pulled back on the Country of Night and the system of control used by Yokoya.

episodes.title: Caution
episodes.summary: Yokoya learns of Akiyama's plot and begins his counter-strategy.

episodes.title: Solidarity
episodes.summary: The Contraband Game reaches its climax and the final standings are revealed.

episodes.title: Spearhead Match
episodes.summary: The rules for the Spearhead Match are explained and Fukunaga comes strong out of the gate.

episodes.title: Trap
episodes.summary: Nao notices a contradiction in the Spearhead Match incentives.

episodes.title: Core Match
episodes.summary: The middle-level match of the loser's bracket, a mock game of "17 (Seventeen) Poker," begins. Nao takes part in the mock game herself, learning the detailed rules while being scolded by Fukunaga. It's basically the same as poker, but the big difference is the presence of the "joker," which is incredibly powerful. The outcome of the game depends on whether or not you have a joker in your hand, so you'll be in trouble if you play with the same mindset as in regular poker. So Nao suggests marking the cards to control the game. However, new cards are used every time, making card cheating impossible, and Nao suffers a crushing defeat in the mock game, receiving a severe reprimand from Fukunaga. Meanwhile, her opponent Kikuchi reports that he has found a surefire way to win, and asserts that this method can only be used by him.
